# Zenotes AI Agent Integration Guide

> Zenotes is a privacy-first note-taking and knowledge base application.
> Notes are formatted in Markdown with support for multi-file and directory uploads.

## Master Global Token Authentication
Agents can access all notes and directories without session cookies by providing the master global token:
- HTTP Header: `X-Global-Token: <YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- Or HTTP Header: `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- Or URL Parameter: `?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`

## API Endpoints
- **Search & List Notes**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes?q={query}&token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- **Get Note Markdown**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/markdown?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- **Download File**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/files/{fileId}?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- **Export Note ZIP**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes/{noteId}/export.zip?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- **Export All Notes & Directories ZIP**: `GET https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/export-all.zip?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`
- **Web UI Global Console**: `https://zenotes.site/global?token=<YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>`

## Quick Example
```bash
curl -s -H "X-Global-Token: <YOUR_GLOBAL_TOKEN>" "https://api.zenotes.site/api/global/notes?q="
```
